# Nebius — Nebius for Startups

Compute credits and discounts for AI startups, available only through Nebius venture capital partner funds. No credit amount is published.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

FAQ "Who can apply?" lists: "VC or accelerator-backed"; "Have raised at least $5M+ USD from one of our approved VC partners" (a FLOOR, not a ceiling); "Building or scaling an AI-enabled product or model"; "Maintain a working company website"; "Apply using a company email address"; "Officially incorporated fewer than 5 years ago". accelerator_required is left unknown because the page says "VC or accelerator-backed" (either satisfies) while separately requiring $5M+ from an approved VC partner. The free founder community is described as "open to all AI startups globally", but that is the community, not the credit program, so no geographic claim is recorded for the credits.
